resources.string: The same command and explicitly chosen interpreter are used for the reviewed devices. Incompatible or unauthorized devices are skipped. Commands run in the agent service context and can modify or delete data. Up to 64000 characters; do not include passwords or tokens. Output reception does not prove successful completion. Captured output is limited to 16000 characters per device and 262144 in total. One attempt per device, no automatic resend. Closing or stopping pending requests ends local monitoring but does not stop remote processes already started.
